title: Zelle owner EWS says it plans to expand the payment service to India later this year, its first international market, and create its own USD-backed stablecoin (Associated Press)
summary: Associated Press: Zelle owner EWS says it plans to expand the payment service to India later this year, its first international market, and create its own USD-backed stablecoin — Peer-to-peer payment service Zelle will expand to India later this year, the payment service's first international market since …
